result.topic_en: Notes on expressing z through a complex variable via linear fractional (Möbius) substitutions, with the transformation of the derivative and of the quantities 1/sqrt(dZ/dz) and Z/sqrt(dZ/dz).
result.transcription:

$\mathfrak{z} \mp \mathfrak{z}' \parallel \frac{Z-p}{r} \mp \frac{r}{Z'-p'}$

$\frac{\partial Z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}} \mp \frac{ad-bc}{(cZ+d)^2}\frac{\partial Z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}$
$\frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial Z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}} \mp \frac{1}{\sqrt{ad-bc}}\; c\frac{Z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial Z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}} + d\frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial Z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}}$
$\frac{Z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial Z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}} \mp \frac{1}{\sqrt{ad-bc}}\; a\frac{Z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial Z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}} + b\frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial Z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}}$

methods.what: Relation between z-values via linear fractional expressions of Z
Different branches of Z for the same z are related by a Möbius transformation
Transformation of the derivative under a Möbius transformation
1/sqrt(Z') and Z/sqrt(Z') transform linearly (as a pair) under the Möbius transformation
